name: whiteboard-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-whiteboard — the Whiteboard row inside the Workspace nav popover, ported from aw-workspace-ui's hardcoded WorkspaceNav.jsx block and registered into the core.nav.workspace slot. src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle. The full floating-window body (src/WhiteboardWindow.jsx) stays staged/unbuilt here — the framework doesn't support component-mode WINDOW bodies yet, only nav slots (see that file's own header comment) — the window itself is still owned by aw-workspace-ui's own (now correctly-routed) WhiteboardWindow.jsx.
